name: music-toggle
title: Music Toggle
description: A round record whose cover art turns while a track plays, ringed by a pink progress arc. A centre button toggles play and pause, and a small bar waveform pulses beside the title and artist.
use: A page needs a small, characterful now-playing control without a full transport bar.
avoid: The progress ring ignores the pointer, so seeking works only from the keyboard.
a11y: The seek ring has pointer events disabled, so mouse users cannot scrub it even though it looks draggable. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: respected)
looks: A dark rounded card holding a circular record of meadow cover art with a small dark hub and a thin pink arc around part of its rim. To the right sit a white title, a grey artist line and a short row of thin light bars.
behaves: While playing, the cover turns steadily and the bars bounce in a repeating ripple as the pink ring fills with progress. Pressing the centre swaps pause bars for a play triangle, halts the spin and flattens the waveform, and the ring can be moved with the arrow keys to seek.
customise: Pass cover, title, artist, progress and playing, plus an optional audio src; the size, bar count and brand colour come from props or the --color-brand variable.
weight: light: One rotating image, a progress ring and two dozen tiny animated bars.
